title: Add the build-response witness contract and CLI
intent: Record the contract for one working instrument's physical evidence without treating whole-instrument measurements as intrinsic wood properties, and without opening literature comparison, scientific approval, production, CAM, or machine authority.
behavior_change: Adds a library and five CLIs for an external evidence package. No API route, calculator, or existing evidence record changes.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Schemas, an unexported build-witness library, create/ingest/verify/analyze/report scripts, synthetic tests, and the investigation note. No real recording or photograph is committed.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: LtbStoredEvidenceArtifactV1 stores one proposal quantity. It is not a multi-file build-response package, and no existing contract classifies whole-instrument audio as BUILD_RESPONSE_WITNESS.

commands_run: cd services/api && python -m pytest tests/physical_engineering/test_build_witness_contract.py tests/physical_engineering/test_build_witness_integrity.py tests/physical_engineering/test_build_witness_measurements.py tests/physical_engineering/test_evidence_artifact_v1.py -q --no-cov -> 60 passed, 1 skipped (Windows: case-collision test skips on a case-insensitive filesystem)

cd services/api && python -m pytest tests/ -q --no-cov -x (Windows) -> 2133 passed, 2 skipped, stopped at 1 failure outside this PR: tests/cam/test_translator_execution_quarantine.py::TestQuarantineIndex::test_get_latest_quarantine (no CAM/translator file in this diff; full suite is covered by hosted CI)
python -m app.ci.check_duplication --threshold 100 -> OK, 0 clone groups within threshold
